title: Redis RESP (REdis Serialization Protocol)

structure.meaning: '+' + string + '\r\n'. No binary data, no newlines.

notes: RESP is human-readable and easy to parse.
RESP2 (default) has 5 types: Simple String, Error, Integer, Bulk String, Array.
RESP3 (Redis 6+) adds 8 more types for richer data (Maps, Sets, Doubles, etc.).

Redis commands are sent as arrays of bulk strings: *3
 $3
 SET
 $3
 key
 $5
 value
.
Pub/sub uses Push messages (RESP3) or inline messages (RESP2).
